page.overview:
What is Capta Est Tower?

The Capta Est Tower is a location in Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. This is the eighth region of the game and can be explored in the eighth chapter of the story mode.

This region contains a volcano on the west and towers on the east, divided by a forest.

Capta Est Tower is located at the south west of Imber Manor, at the west of Snowy Peaks of Crudelis and at north of the Utopia Niveus.

See Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia Story Act 1 script#Ch. 8: Capta Est Tower
